scope: single EA instance lifecycle (same MT5 terminal process attachment)
structure: dynamic string array g_seenSignalIds — linear membership test IsAlreadySeenSignalId before trade path
remember_policy: RememberSignalId called after successful Buy/Sell (EXECUTED) or failed trade return (BROKER_REJECT) so the same signal_id is never re-sent in the same session
replay_behavior: EA_PARSE_FAIL and SIGNAL_SKIP paths do not Remember — operator may correct payload and re-append with same signal_id if desired
tail_read: g_lastFilePos seeded to EOF in OnInit — prevents processing entire history after chart reattach without relying solely on dedupe RAM
log_token: DUPLICATE_SKIP with msg explaining same signal_id already processed this session
